```{=html}
<!-- Figure 4: maximal qubit root S on the Bloch ball, animated. Skeleton SVG (ball wireframe + axes + poles + I/2 + data-* + empty layers) from bloch_root_figure.py; the script builds the resting axis orbits and the cloud-collapse animation (z->y->x->0) from S. Autoplay on scroll, tap to replay, reduced-motion/JS-off => static ball. -->
<style>
.bloch-root-animated{max-width:520px;margin:1.25rem auto;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;}
.bloch-root-animated svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;}
.bloch-root-animated .bl-hint{margin:.4rem 0 0;text-align:center;font-size:13px;color:#9aa9b5;}
.bloch-root-animated .bl-vh{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);border:0;}
</style>
<div class="bloch-root-animated">
<p class="bl-vh">Animation of the maximal qubit root S on the Bloch ball. A cloud of Bloch vectors is driven by S to the maximally mixed centre I/2 in stages, each step shrinking and rotating it onto the next axis (z to y to x to 0). Three pure axis states are highlighted: the z-pole takes three steps (the hero, realising the order-3 bound), the y-axis two, the x-axis one. Plays once when scrolled into view; tap to replay.</p>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 640" font-family="Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif" role="img" aria-label="The maximal qubit root S driving Bloch vectors to the centre in stages" data-cx="320" data-cy="332" data-r="210" data-alpha-deg="35" data-elev-deg="20">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5"
            markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#233746"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="arrowG" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5"
            markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#829aa6"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="arrowB" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5"
            markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#1565c0"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- Silhouette (pure-state boundary) -->
  <circle cx="320.0" cy="332.0" r="210.0" fill="none" stroke="#2d6f8f" stroke-width="2.2"/>

  <!-- Coordinate axes -->
  <line x1="320.00" y1="332.00" x2="522.99" y2="380.61" stroke="#233746" stroke-width="1.8" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
  <line x1="320.00" y1="332.00" x2="177.87" y2="401.43" stroke="#233746" stroke-width="1.8" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
  <line x1="320.00" y1="529.34" x2="320.00" y2="99.14" stroke="#233746" stroke-width="1.8" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>

  <!-- Layers filled by the script (resting orbits, trails, cloud, hero) -->
  <g class="resting"></g>
  <g class="trails"></g>
  <g class="cloud"></g>
  <g class="hl"></g>

  <!-- Maximally mixed state I/2 (recessed, depth-cued) -->
  <circle cx="320.0" cy="332.0" r="8.5" fill="#f5f7f8" fill-opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="320.0" cy="332.0" r="5.5" fill="#5e7886" fill-opacity="0.85"/>

  <!-- Labels -->
  <text x="300.00" y="124.66" text-anchor="end" font-size="21" font-style="italic" fill="#233746">|0⟩</text>
  <text x="320.00" y="563.34" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" font-style="italic" fill="#233746">|1⟩</text>
  <text x="564.27" y="396.50" text-anchor="middle" font-size="20" font-style="italic" fill="#233746">x</text>
  <text x="144.96" y="421.55" text-anchor="end" font-size="20" font-style="italic" fill="#233746">y</text>
  <text x="328.00" y="71.52" text-anchor="start" font-size="20" font-style="italic" fill="#233746">z</text>
  <text x="334.00" y="330.00" text-anchor="start" font-size="20" fill="#5e7886">I/2</text>
</svg>
<p class="bl-hint">Plays once on scroll. Tap to replay.</p>
</div>
<script>
(function(){
  var NS="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  function el(t,a){var e=document.createElementNS(NS,t);for(var k in a)e.setAttribute(k,a[k]);return e;}
  var PURE=[45,111,143], MIXED=[214,229,234];
  function lerp(a,b,u){var r=[];for(var i=0;i<a.length;i++)r.push(a[i]+(b[i]-a[i])*u);return r;}
  function ease(t){return t<0.5?4*t*t*t:1-Math.pow(-2*t+2,3)/2;}

  function setup(root){
    var svg=root.querySelector('svg'); if(!svg) return;
    var CX=parseFloat(svg.dataset.cx),CY=parseFloat(svg.dataset.cy),R=parseFloat(svg.dataset.r);
    var A=parseFloat(svg.dataset.alphaDeg)*Math.PI/180, E=parseFloat(svg.dataset.elevDeg)*Math.PI/180;
    var cA=Math.cos(A),sA=Math.sin(A),cE=Math.cos(E),sE=Math.sin(E);
    function project(p){var x=p[0],y=p[1],z=p[2];var u=R*(x*cA-y*sA);var w=x*sA+y*cA;var v=R*(z*cE-w*sE);var d=z*sE+w*cE;return [CX+u,CY-v,d];}
    function applyS(r){return [r[1]/2,r[2]/2,0];}
    function mag(r){return Math.sqrt(r[0]*r[0]+r[1]*r[1]+r[2]*r[2]);}
    function colof(r){var t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,r[0]*r[0]+r[1]*r[1]+r[2]*r[2]));var c=[];for(var k=0;k<3;k++)c.push(Math.round(MIXED[k]+t*(PURE[k]-MIXED[k])));return 'rgb('+c[0]+','+c[1]+','+c[2]+')';}
    function frontOp(d){return 0.45+0.55*Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(d+1)/2));}

    function g(n){return svg.querySelector('g.'+n);}
    var gRest=g('resting'),gTrail=g('trails'),gCloud=g('cloud'),gHL=g('hl');
    function clear(n){while(n.firstChild)n.removeChild(n.firstChild);}

    function orbit(s){var o=[s.slice()];for(var i=0;i<3;i++)o.push(applyS(o[o.length-1]));return o;}
    var HERO='#1565c0', GREY='#829aa6';
    var defs=[{o:orbit([0,0,1]),col:HERO,hero:true},{o:orbit([0,1,0]),col:GREY,hero:false},{o:orbit([1,0,0]),col:GREY,hero:false}];

    function arrow(a,b,col,w,op){
      var dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1],L=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy); if(L<14)return null;
      var ux=dx/L,uy=dy/L,s=[a[0]+8*ux,a[1]+8*uy],e=[b[0]-9*ux,b[1]-9*uy];
      return el('line',{x1:s[0],y1:s[1],x2:e[0],y2:e[1],stroke:col,'stroke-width':w,opacity:op,'stroke-linecap':'round','marker-end':'url(#'+(col===HERO?'arrowB':'arrowG')+')'});
    }
    function buildResting(){
      clear(gRest);
      defs.forEach(function(h){
        var o=h.o, pr=o.map(project);
        for(var i=0;i<o.length-1;i++){var m=(mag(o[i])+mag(o[i+1]))/2;var op=(0.30+0.60*Math.min(1,m)).toFixed(3);var ar=arrow(pr[i],pr[i+1],h.col,h.hero?2.7:2.0,op);if(ar)gRest.appendChild(ar);}
        for(var j=1;j<o.length-1;j++){var p=pr[j];var op=(0.22+0.63*Math.min(1,mag(o[j]))).toFixed(3);gRest.appendChild(el('circle',{cx:p[0],cy:p[1],r:5,fill:colof(o[j]),'fill-opacity':op,stroke:'#1c4a60','stroke-width':1.2,'stroke-opacity':op}));}
        var ps=pr[0];gRest.appendChild(el('circle',{cx:ps[0],cy:ps[1],r:h.hero?6.5:5.5,fill:colof(o[0]),stroke:h.hero?'#0d3f8f':'#1c4a60','stroke-width':1.4}));
      });
    }

    var cloud=[],hl=[];
    function buildAnim(){
      clear(gCloud);clear(gHL);clear(gTrail);cloud=[];hl=[];
      for(var i=0;i<150;i++){
        var th=Math.acos(2*Math.random()-1), ph=2*Math.PI*Math.random();
        var n=[Math.sin(th)*Math.cos(ph),Math.sin(th)*Math.sin(ph),Math.cos(th)];
        var rad=Math.pow(Math.random(),1/3);
        var r0=[rad*n[0],rad*n[1],rad*n[2]];
        var s=[r0];for(var k=0;k<3;k++)s.push(applyS(s[s.length-1]));
        var dot=el('circle',{r:2.8});gCloud.appendChild(dot);
        cloud.push({s:s,dot:dot});
      }
      defs.forEach(function(h){
        var tr=el('polyline',{fill:'none',stroke:h.col,'stroke-width':h.hero?2.7:2.0,'stroke-opacity':0.6,'stroke-linecap':'round','stroke-linejoin':'round'});gTrail.appendChild(tr);
        var d=el('circle',{r:h.hero?6.5:5.5,fill:h.col,stroke:h.hero?'#0d3f8f':'#1c4a60','stroke-width':1.3});gHL.appendChild(d);
        hl.push({o:h.o,dot:d,trail:tr,path:[]});
      });
    }

    var MOVE=900,DWELL=350,HOLD=900;
    var seq=[['m',0],['d',0],['m',1],['d',1],['m',2],['h',2]], durs=[MOVE,DWELL,MOVE,DWELL,MOVE,HOLD];
    var DUR=durs.reduce(function(a,b){return a+b;},0);
    function stateAt(o,t){for(var i=0;i<seq.length;i++){var kind=seq[i][0],si=seq[i][1],du=durs[i];if(t<du){if(kind==='m')return lerp(o[si],o[si+1],ease(t/du));return o[si+1];}t-=du;}return o[3];}
    function showMode(anim){gRest.style.display=anim?'none':'';gCloud.style.display=anim?'':'none';gHL.style.display=anim?'':'none';gTrail.style.display=anim?'':'none';}

    var running=false;
    function animate(){
      if(running)return;running=true;buildAnim();showMode(true);var t0=null;
      function frame(now){if(t0===null)t0=now;var t=now-t0;if(t>DUR)t=DUR;var i,st,pr;
        for(i=0;i<cloud.length;i++){st=stateAt(cloud[i].s,t);pr=project(st);cloud[i].dot.setAttribute('cx',pr[0]);cloud[i].dot.setAttribute('cy',pr[1]);cloud[i].dot.setAttribute('fill',colof(st));cloud[i].dot.setAttribute('fill-opacity',frontOp(pr[2]).toFixed(3));}
        for(i=0;i<hl.length;i++){st=stateAt(hl[i].o,t);pr=project(st);hl[i].path.push(pr[0]+','+pr[1]);hl[i].trail.setAttribute('points',hl[i].path.join(' '));hl[i].dot.setAttribute('cx',pr[0]);hl[i].dot.setAttribute('cy',pr[1]);}
        if(t<DUR)requestAnimationFrame(frame);else setTimeout(function(){running=false;showMode(false);},700);
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }

    buildResting();showMode(false);
    var reduce=window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    if(!reduce){
      svg.style.cursor='pointer';
      svg.addEventListener('click',animate);
      if('IntersectionObserver' in window){var seen=false;var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){for(var i=0;i<es.length;i++){if(es[i].isIntersecting&&!seen){seen=true;animate();}}},{threshold:0.25});io.observe(svg);}
      else animate();
    }
  }
  function init(){var rs=document.querySelectorAll('.bloch-root-animated');for(var i=0;i<rs.length;i++)setup(rs[i]);}
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init);
  else init();
})();
</script>
```
